detail.longDescription:
This TV remote app is made specifically for Smart TVs. Simply connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi, pair them up, and you're good to go. 
 
The app has all the buttons you need. So, you don’t have to scramble for your TV remote or purchase a new one if it breaks down. 

Key features include: 
- A fully working TV remote for your Smart TV; 
- A big touchpad for easy browsing through the menu and content; 
- A keyboard 
– The app connects automatically to your device

We offer different plans for premium: weekly ($3.99), Monthly ($7.99) & Lifetime ($14.99).
